title: My Desk and My Cat · 写作迁移
instructions: 写2—8个简单句、至少12词，介绍一张桌子、桌上的一件物品以及桌边的一位人物；可以自编场景。He/She指人物，It指物品；a/an按紧接着的读音选择，不要求把两种冠词硬塞进每句话。
prompt: Write 2–8 simple sentences about a desk, an object on it, and one person beside it. The scene may be real or invented. Use This is to introduce something, It is for an object, and He is or She is for the person. Use a or an where appropriate. Write at least 12 words.
